versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the parachute landing system minimizes dragging of the air vehicle after landing. Standard: Means are provided to minimize dragging of the air vehicle across the recovery surface (e.g., ground and water) due to winds and currents. Method of Compliance: Demonstrations verify that the air vehicle is not dragged by the parachute across the recovery surface after landing. Reference: JSSG-2010: 3.12 Deployable Aerodynamic Decelerator (DAD) System

Standard: Parachute landing system provides a means to release the parachute(s) after touchdown to minimize dragging of the air vehicle across the landing surface (e.g., ground and water) during all operating conditions (e.g., high winds and currents). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review system design documents to verify parachute release system is incorporated. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct ground demonstration to verify that the air vehicle is not dragged by the parachute landing system across the recovery surface after landing.
